guide.title: VLA Radio galaxy 3C 129: P-band continuum tutorial-CASA6.7.2

slice.why: The guide images spw='3~8' ("the cleanest spectral windows that are totally RFI free") and names spws 1,2 and 9,10 as continuous-RFI windows ("these spectral windows (spws 1,2 and 9,10, but possibly more) can be immediately flagged."). spws 2~9 keep the six imaging spws plus one RFI spw on each side, with the same 320 MHz centre as spw 3~8. Hanning first (guide 7c), then 2-channel and 2-integration averaging bring the input to about 2.5 GB (estimate from 8 spw x 378 baselines x ~356 integrations x 64 ch x 4 corr; not measured until build).
slice.effect_on_guide_numbers: Guide numbers refer to the full band. The 37% flagged fraction is not expected to hold on the slice (not measured). The guide gives no image rms, peak, or beam measurement, so no slice-scaled image target exists (no DERIVED rms).

non_standard: Hanning smoothing is applied by the builder (guide 7c), because any DATA rewrite by the agent would break the raw_data_unmodified hard gate.
Ionospheric TEC correction (tec_maps / gencal tecim) is skipped in builder and oracles: it downloads IGS maps and the builder and containers are offline.
gencal antpos uses the guide's 17 logged offsets as explicit parameters instead of the online archive lookup.
Verifier recipe uses gridder='standard' with imsize 1024 (1.4 deg) and threshold '0mJy' because VerifierTcleanRecipe has no wprojplanes field; status CHOICE.
Oracle image uses the guide tclean with imsize 2048 instead of 4860 and auto-multithresh instead of interactive masking; status CHOICE; runtime not measured.
post_calibrate/input.ms drops MODEL_DATA to keep the image-stage input smaller.
run.py registers this suite in radio_bench.render_jobs suite dicts at runtime because the render_jobs CLI only knows synth and 3c391.
open: Guide has no number for image rms, peak, dynamic range, restored beam, or flux of 3C129: residual-rms upper ramp removed, DR uses the 150 convention floor only.
Guide has no number for 3C147 setjy flux density: precal model target is DERIVED at build.
Guide has no number for bandpass phase flatness or gain scatter ("a few percent" only): convention tolerances used.
No observable for delay values, so the guide's 30 ns statement is recorded but not scored.
No fluxscale check is possible: there is no secondary calibrator; fluxscale_score dropped from calibrate and e2e rubrics.
No selfcal stage is gradeable, so the guide's self-calibration section is not covered.
